name: Yadda ake Gina Kwamfuta na Musamman don Harshen Alkyl
description: Jagorar mataki-mataki don rubuta mai nazari na lexical, parser, da janareta na lamba don yaren shirye-shiryen Alkyl.

steps.name: Nazarin Lexical
steps.text: Ƙayyade alamu don Alkyl kuma samar da lexer ta amfani da Flex.

steps.name: Fassarar Magana
steps.text: Ƙirƙiri dokokin nahawu kuma gina Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) ta amfani da Bison.

steps.name: Code Generation
steps.text: Matsa AST don fitar da Wakilin Matsakaici na LLVM (IR).

name: Yadda Ake Gyara Zazzagewar Layout a Next.js
description: Jagorar mataki-mataki don cire ma'aunin DOM na aiki tare da gyara shimfidar wuri.

steps.name: Gano Kwallon Kwallon
steps.text: Bude Chrome DevTools, je zuwa Performance tab, kuma yi rikodin nauyin shafi don nemo sake kwararar tilas.

steps.name: Dakata Ma'aunin DOM
steps.text: Matsar da getBoundingClientRect() kira cikin buƙatunAnimationFrame ko tosheTimeout.

name: Yadda ake Haɓaka Mahimmancin Yanar Gizon Mahimmanci don Fayiloli
description: Inganta maki LCP, CLS, da TBT a cikin Next.js 14 don cimma cikakkiyar makin Hasken Haske 100.

steps.name: Inganta Hotuna
steps.text: Yi amfani da Next.js gaba/bangaren hoto tare da fifiko da ɗaukoPriority don hotuna na sama-da-ninka.

steps.name: Rage TBT
steps.text: Tsayar da rubutun ɓangare na uku marasa mahimmanci kuma yi amfani da amfani da React don ɗaukakawar UI mai nauyi.

name: Yadda ake cin Gasar Lissafin ONMIPA
description: Dabaru na nazari da dabarun warware matsaloli don ONMIPA-PT.

steps.name: Jagora Mahimmanci
steps.text: Tabbatar da ƙwaƙƙwaran fahimtar Bincike na Gaskiya, Algebra Linear, da Complex Variables.

steps.name: Warware Takardun da suka gabata
steps.text: Yi aiki tare da ONMIPA takaddun da suka gabata daga shekarun baya a ƙarƙashin ƙayyadaddun yanayi.

name: Yadda Ake Gina Palette Na Musamman A Cikin React
description: Ƙirƙirar palette mai sauƙi, mai sauri, kuma mai sarrafa madanni ta amfani da React da Framer Motion.

steps.name: Gudanar da Jiha
steps.text: Yi amfani da kantin sayar da duniya (Zustand ko yanayi) don sarrafa buɗe/kusa da yanayin palette.

steps.name: Masu Sauraron Allon madannai
steps.text: Haɗa mai sauraron taron don Ctrl+K ko Cmd+K don kunna palette.

steps.name: Bincike mai ban tsoro
steps.text: Aiwatar da algorithm bincike mai ban mamaki don tace umarni bisa shigar da mai amfani.

name: Yadda ake Aiwatar da i18n a Next.js App Router
description: Jagoran mataki-mataki don tallafawa yarukan gida da yawa a hankali a cikin na'ura mai ba da hanya tsakanin hanyoyin sadarwa na Next.js App.

steps.name: Ƙirƙiri Middleware
steps.text: Yi amfani da Next.js Middleware don gano yaren da mai amfani ya fi so kuma a tura su zuwa madaidaicin hanyar gida.

steps.name: Load Dictionaries
steps.text: Ƙirƙiri ayyukan async don ɗauko madaidaicin ƙamus na JSON bisa ma'aunin URL.

name: Yadda ake Ƙirƙirar Hotunan Taswirar Yanar Gizon 3D Mai Mu'amala
description: Yi tunanin tsarin haɗin yanar gizo na ciki ta amfani da react-force-graph-3d.

steps.name: Taswirar Nodes
steps.text: Cire duk hanyoyin haɗin ciki da shafuka don ƙirƙirar saitin bayanan haɗin gwiwa.

steps.name: Sanya Graph
steps.text: Shigar da saitin bayanai zuwa ForceGraph3D kuma keɓance launukan kumburi da girma.

name: Yadda ake Miƙa URLs zuwa Bing IndexNow
description: Sanar da Bing ta atomatik da sauran injunan bincike lokacin da abun cikin ku ya canza ta amfani da IndexNow API.

steps.name: Ƙirƙirar Maɓallin API
steps.text: Ƙirƙirar maɓallin hex mai haruffa 32 kuma karɓe shi a tushen yankinku azaman fayil txt.

steps.name: Aika Buƙatun POST
steps.text: Yi amfani da debo don aika kaya na JSON mai ɗauke da duk sabbin URLs ɗinku zuwa ƙarshen IndexNow.

name: Yadda ake Samar da Lo-Fi Beats tare da LMMS
description: Jagorar mafari don tsara kiɗan lo-fi hip hop mai annashuwa ta amfani da buɗaɗɗen DAWs.

steps.name: Saita Tempo
steps.text: Saita BPM aikin ku tsakanin 70 da 90.

steps.name: Ƙirƙiri maƙallan maƙallan
steps.text: Yi amfani da maƙallan jazzy na 7 ko na 9 akan kayan aikin piano na lantarki tare da ɗan ƙarami.

steps.name: Ƙara Ganguna
steps.text: Shirya hutun ganga mai ƙura tare da jujjuyawa mara ƙididdigewa.

name: Yadda ake Rubuta Nazarin Harka na Fasaha
description: Rubuta ayyukan injiniyan software ɗinku yadda ya kamata don masu daukar ma'aikata da masu haɓakawa.

steps.name: Bayyana Matsala
steps.text: Fara da bayyana a sarari ƙalubalen fasaha ko buƙatun kasuwanci.

steps.name: Bayyana Magani
steps.text: Cikakkun abubuwan gine-gine, fasahar da aka yi amfani da su, da aiwatar da mataki-mataki.

steps.name: Hana Tasirin
steps.text: Samar da ma'auni, kamar haɓaka aiki ko haɓakar mai amfani, don tabbatar da nasarar.
